as_told.title: Sardinian giant graveyard cleared by men in vans and tower passage sealed

plain: A man who was 101 years old recalled that, in the 1920s or 1930s, men ploughing land for a vineyard near a nuraghe, one of the ancient stone towers of Sardinia, suddenly began digging up the remains of gigantic people. He said a group of vans then pulled up, people got out carrying equipment, and he hid; they took the remains away, and a passage in the tower was sealed. Tim Alberino, a guest who looks into stories of ancient giants, passes this on, crediting a person named Anna Tuary, and tells it twice, adding the vans and the sealed passage the second time, as a sign that evidence of giants was found and removed.
